title: Scene List
description: Produced by stage 3, finalized by stage 4 (recheck). Scenes are clip units sized to the active video model: <=15s (Seedance 2.0, default) or <=30s (Seedance 2.5, d-204).

est_duration_seconds.description: <= the active video model's max clip length: 15 for Seedance 2.0 (default), 30 for Seedance 2.5 (d-204, Director-ordered). Stage 3 enforces the per-model ceiling; the schema caps the absolute maximum.

transition_out_hint.description: Suggested transition into the next scene.

boundary_class_out.description: [SEAM d-211] Class of the boundary INTO the next scene: continuous (action crosses the cut — last resort, requires overlap plan), new_beat (same world, new dramatic unit), hinge (location/time change). Optional for backward compatibility; stage 4 enforces presence when seam_policy.boundary_classes_required is true.

overlap_from.description: [SEAM d-211] Continuous boundaries only: the predecessor scene_id whose final beat this scene RE-COVERS (overlap generation, d-213).

overlap_seconds.description: [SEAM d-211] Continuous boundaries only: how many seconds of the predecessor's final beat the successor re-generates (3-4 typical). Generated twice, appears once - accounted for in total_est_seconds.

head_action.description: [SEAM d-211] The motion this scene OPENS with - a new motion beginning (cut on motion onset). Never a settle.
